safety_lead_time.comparison_action: DECREASE: Recommended safety lead time is below SAP

narrative: Inventory optimization completed for PL1__MA42A342. Demand regime classified as erratic with Normal distribution. Lead time stability is unstable. Optimized policy achieves $14,547.18 annual savings (74.3%) compared to current SAP policy.

research_insights.selected_model: EOQ with safety stock (stochastic demand and lead time)
research_insights.selection_rationale: Normal demand distribution (CV=0.22) with variable lead times (CV_LT=0.74) justifies classic EOQ model with safety stock buffer using combined variability formula.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Lead time instability (CV>0.6) increases buffer requirement; transport variance is dominant contributor.
